headline: Tired of Your Bathroom Tile? Here's How to Upgrade
articleBody: If your bathroom tile is looking a little worse for wear or just completely out of style, you're probably dreaming of a fresh new look. Many folks wonder how long a tile project actually takes, or if they can just tile right over their old surfaces. Typically, upgrading involves carefully removing the old, damaged, or dated finishes first. Then, we meticulously check and prep the substrate, ensuring it's level and ready for new materials. This step is super important for a lasting finish! Next comes installing your brand-new tile or other wall/floor finishes, followed by sealing and finishing the joints. The timing for all this really depends on how much demolition is needed, and any drying or curing times. Plus, if we're dealing with any hidden plumbing or electrical systems, we'll need to coordinate with those trades. When you're choosing new materials, think about durability, moisture resistance, and how easy they are to clean. If you're looking at a shower surround, or a floor that needs careful sloping for drainage, a skilled tile installer is going to be your best friend.
